profile_text.body:
Writer is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI agent platform built to help teams execute and scale on-brand, compliant work, and states it is trusted by Fortune 500 companies. It emphasizes a five-year track record of AI research and large language model innovation, positioning transparency, reliability, and control as core enterprise requirements it addresses.

The company's primary product is Writer.com, an enterprise writing AI platform that incorporates brand governance, style guide enforcement, hallucination detection, and its proprietary PALMYRA language models. The platform supports agentic workflows and is aimed particularly at marketing teams within Global 2000 and enterprise organizations. Writer also offers certifications, self-paced courses, and video tutorials covering generative AI fundamentals through custom AI agent construction.

The held facts note that Writer has 175 items of legal exposure catalogued under California, though no specific cases are listed. The company also has an associated MCP server entry for DocuWriter.ai, a documentation tool offering 72 tools including an Autopilot feature for generating, searching, and managing codebase documentation.
